Republicans must put patriotic duty over party loyalty.

And join House Democrats to pass a War Powers Resolution.

To stop Donald Trump's reckless war of choice in the Middle East. Immediately.

Video

We need a permanent end to Donald Trump’s reckless, costly and dangerous war of choice.

Nothing less is sufficient.

Video

Republicans must end their cult-like allegiance to Donald Trump.

For the good of the nation and the free world.

Congress must immediately end this reckless war of choice in Iran before Donald Trump plunges us into World War III.

It’s time for every single Republican to put patriotic duty over party and stop the madness.

Enough.

Republicans are threatening to cut Medicare and Medicaid.

To pay for Donald Trump’s reckless war of choice in the Middle East.

Get lost.

Disgusting and unhinged Easter message from Donald Trump.

Something is really wrong with this guy.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Thankful that the second Air Force officer whose fighter jet was shot down in Iran has been heroically rescued by U.S. Special Operations.

What a blessing on Easter Sunday morning.

May God continue to watch over our troops.

The economy is a mess, a reckless war is raging in the Middle East and costs are out of control.

Republicans promised a Golden Age of America.

How is that working out?

Closely monitoring the news that an F-15 has been shot down in Iran.

Praying for the crew as well as the safety of all the troops involved in the search and rescue effort. 

May God continue to watch over all our service members in harm's way.

Pam Bondi has been fired.

Good riddance.

Pete Hegseth is next.

House Republicans must end their taxpayer-funded vacation.

It’s time to pass the bipartisan Senate bill and end the GOP shutdown.

Immediately.

Video

The American people are sick and tired of the chaos, high costs and extreme Republican agenda.

Donald Trump must end his reckless war of choice in the Middle East.

Now.

Chag Pesach Sameach to everyone celebrating in Brooklyn and throughout the nation!

May this be a meaningful holiday and a season inspired by the freedom, resilience and hope of the Jewish people across generations.
Statement on the Trump-Republican DHS Shutdown.

Republicans plan to pay for Donald Trump’s reckless war of choice by cutting billions from healthcare and SNAP.

The GOP did the same thing last year to fund ICE brutality and violence.

Every single one of these extremists is unfit to govern.

Video

Republicans are complete phonies with their voter suppression scheme.

#TrumpVotedByMail

Gas is over $4 a gallon.

Donald Trump’s reckless war of choice is making your life more expensive.

You deserve better.

There is a bipartisan bill to end the chaos at airports.

House Republicans rejected it and left town on vacation.

Bring the House back. End the GOP shutdown.

NOW.

Republicans created chaos at airports across America.

They can end it tomorrow.

Bring the House back. Pass the bipartisan bill. Pay TSA.

The American people deserve better.
